If you haven't been to /v/subverserequest lately then you might be completely unaware of what I'm going to describe so I'll recap. Subverserequest is where people can go to take over subverses from inactive mods and users, or even from subverses that have no mods whatsoever. However, it has been 47 days since the last subverse request was fulfilled. There have been posts critical of this on Voat over the past month or so and I was going to make a similar post - but I don't think that is the real problem here.

I think that in a lot of ways, whether by accident or design, Voat has become anti-content. On top of the lack of transfers we have more restrictions on new users generating content than ever before, there are hourly quotas on posting to subverses, and i have limits on subverses that I mod on how much i can post there. Voat needs more content and users in order to survive. We also need in the diversity of content that is posted here - which is why it's ridiculous that people can't take subs that have been abandoned for 6 months or more in a timely manner.

We also suffer from a lack of revenue. Now this has been an obvious problem and I respect the admins for being transparent on this issue. The problem is that the users are willing to work with you on ways to generate revenue and they seem to be ignored. There have been users asking for ads in order to help keep voat afloat. There were also multiple posts before this where people asked ways that they could donate to voat to keep it running and running well and those also were seemingly ignored. To me, it seems like Voat is trying to stay alive long enough to get a high enough bid from a potential buyer and then jump ship. I might be being pessimistic, but it just doesn't seem like the drive to keep voat alive has been there.

I could be talking out of my ass, but I feel like this is something Voat has been suffering from for a long time. If the admins are too busy checking our bits to handle remedial tasks like subverse requests, that's completely okay. You're the admins, we understand that you can be busy. But there are plenty of reputable users who would be willing to help out with that responsibility as well. And the beautiful thing is, they'll do it for free!

I guess this is where i'm coming from - we all love Voat and what it stands for. We want Voat to thrive and survive for a long time. Let us help you if you need help. Let us help generate the content and revenue. Let us help make Voat great.
The amount of time its takes to transfer subverses is a symptom of a disease that is slowly destroying Voat
